p: Staniforth Road is the main road through Darnall, a busy residential area in the east of Sheffield. It's a lively local high street with plenty of food shops and takeaways, so you won't go hungry while you're in the area.

The Supertram has a stop at Darnall on the line out to Meadowhall, which is only a few minutes away if you want to make a day of it. The Utilita Arena and iceSheffield are also nearby in the Don Valley, while the city centre is a short tram or bus ride in the other direction.
Storeys is 18+ only, so bring ID if you're likely to be asked.
